title: How AI-Ready Is Your Business?
subtitle: 6 questions. 2 minutes. A score that might hurt your feelings.
captureSubtext: Tell us where to send your results. No spam — we're too busy automating things to write newsletters.

questions.text: How many SaaS tools does your team log into every day?
questions.subtext: Be honest. We'll wait while you count the browser tabs.
questions.tooltip: The average small business uses 37 SaaS tools. No, that's not a typo. Yes, you're probably paying for 12 you forgot about.

questions.text: How much time per week does your team spend on tasks a robot should be doing?
questions.subtext: Copy-pasting between apps, manually updating spreadsheets, sending the same email 40 times...
questions.tooltip: If your answer is 'I don't know,' it's probably 10+ hours. The ones who don't know are always the worst offenders.

results.label: Early Stage
results.headline: You're doing everything by hand. That's... brave.
results.summary: Look, there's no shame in it — every business starts here. But you're leaving serious time and money on the table. The good news? The gap between where you are and where you could be is actually the easiest to close. The first automations are always the highest-impact.
results.recommendation: Start with the basics: automate your lead capture, connect your tools, and stop copy-pasting between apps. We wrote a guide for exactly this situation.

results.headline: You've got the foundation — now it's time to build the machine.
results.summary: You know automation exists. You've maybe built a few things. But your systems are still fragmented — data lives in 5 places, follow-up is manual, and your processes depend on specific people remembering specific things. One well-designed automation stack changes everything.
